crossRefs.note: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

translations.web: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.
translations.bsb: All the rivers flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full; to the place from which the streams come, there again they flow.
translations.kjv: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
translations.asv: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full; unto the place whither the rivers go, thither they go again.
